DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知の日付について、どの欄をご覧になって対応不要だと思われたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which date field on the notice made you think no action was needed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 対象期間が先月までになっています。もう過ぎた話だから何もしなくてよいと思いましたが、返信用の紙も入っていて不安になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 対象期間が先月までなので対応不要と思ったが、返信用紙もあり不安と相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The covered period ends last month. I thought it was past business needing nothing, but there was also a reply sheet, so I became worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss thinking no action was needed because the covered period ended last month, but being worried by a reply sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象としている期間と、返事を出す期限は別の場合があります。回答期限の欄を一緒に探してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The covered period and deadline for replying may differ. May we find the reply-deadline field together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに別の日付がありました。対象期間の終わりだけ見て、回答期限を見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象期間末だけを見て別欄の回答期限を見落としたと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is another date here. I only looked at the period's end and missed the reply deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you looked only at the covered period's end and missed the reply deadline in another field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 期限と提出方法は担当に確認しましょう。返信用の紙で、特に記入を迷っている項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the deadline and submission method with staff. Any reply-sheet item you are particularly unsure how to fill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 状況に変更があるかという欄です。私は変わっていないので空欄でよいのか、変更なしと答える必要があるのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 状況が変わらない場合に空欄でよいか変更なしの回答が必要か分からないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The field asking whether my circumstances changed. Mine have not, so I do not know whether blank is fine or I need to answer no change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you do not know whether unchanged circumstances can be left blank or need a no-change answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更がない場合の扱いも、通知の種類に応じて担当へ照会します。期限までに確認したい点を、まとめて伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask staff about unchanged cases too, depending on notice type. Could you summarize what you want to check before the deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 変更なしの場合も回答が必要か、空欄のままではいけないか、それから郵送以外の提出方法があるかを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更なしの回答要否、空欄可否、郵送以外の提出方法の三点を照会したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Whether a reply is needed with no change, whether it must not be left blank, and whether there is a submission method besides post.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to inquire about three points: no-change reply requirement, whether blank is allowed and alternatives to postal submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三点を担当へ伝えましょう。回答が必要となった場合も、送ったことと受付が完了したことは同じとは限らないので、確認方法も尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us pass the three points to staff. Even if a reply is required, sending and completed acceptance may differ, so ask how to check acceptance too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知を手元に担当へ相談し、必要な回答方法と受付確認の仕方をメモします。対象期間が過ぎたという理由で、そのまま捨てるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知を手元に担当へ相談し回答方法と受付確認を記録して、過去の対象期間だけで捨てないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the notice with me, consult staff and note the required reply method and acceptance check. I will not discard it just because the covered period has passed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will consult staff with the notice, note reply and acceptance-check methods and not discard it solely because the covered period is past. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、発行元と件名から担当窓口を確認します。返信用紙はまだ提出せず、通知と一緒に保管して案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will identify the responsible counter from the issuer and subject. Do not submit the reply sheet yet; keep it with the notice and await guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒をお持ちですね。紹介状での受診について、予約のご案内も受けていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an envelope. Have you also received booking guidance for a referral visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別の病院でもらった紹介状です。これを持てば受診する時間も決まっていると思いましたが、私は予約の連絡をしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 他院の紹介状で受診時間も決まると思ったが、自分では予約連絡していないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This referral letter is from another hospital. I thought having it also meant my visit time was fixed, but I have not contacted anyone to book myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you thought another hospital's referral fixed the visit time, but you have not made booking contact yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紹介状と予約の案内は別に確認が必要です。封筒のほかに、日時が書かれた紙や連絡の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The referral letter and booking guidance need separate checks. Apart from the envelope, any paper with a date and time or a record of contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日時の紙はなく、案内には病院へ連絡するよう書かれていました。紹介状を受け取ったことで、予約も済んだと思い込んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日時の紙はなく病院へ連絡との案内があり、紹介状取得で予約済みと思い込んだと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No date-and-time paper; the guidance said to contact the hospital. I assumed receiving the referral meant booking was done too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say there is no time paper, guidance says contact the hospital, and you assumed receiving the referral meant booked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付へ状況を確認します。こちらへ紹介された理由と、今の症状を分かる範囲で教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the situation with reception. Tell us why you were referred here and your current symptoms as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 続いている耳鳴りを相談するよう言われました。先週から同じように聞こえていますが、病名は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 続く耳鳴りの相談で紹介され、先週から同様だが病名は不明と説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was told to discuss continuing ringing in my ears. It has sounded the same since last week, but I do not know the condition's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain referral for continuing tinnitus, the same since last week, but the diagnosis is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 伺った内容を担当へ伝えます。診察や検査の予定はまだ確認中ですので、お持ちの薬の情報なども準備していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell staff that. Consultation and test plans are still being checked, so could you prepare medicine information too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薬の手帳は持っています。紹介状は自分で開かずに担当へ渡し、今日受診できるかと、必要な受付の方法を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬手帳があり紹介状を開かず担当へ渡すと述べ、今日の受診可否と受付方法を確認したいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my medicine notebook. I will hand the referral to staff without opening it myself, and want to check whether I can see a doctor today and the required reception procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have a medicine notebook and will hand the unopened referral to staff, then ask about today's visit availability and reception method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、受付に照会します。今日の診察が決まったわけではありませんが、ご説明のときに言葉の支援など希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will ask reception. Today's examination is not yet decided, but do you want language support or similar help during explanations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受診日が別の日になる場合も、日時と持ち物を紙に書いてほしいです。日本語の案内をその場で聞き返し、予約が取れたかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別日受診でも日時と持ち物を紙で希望し、日本語は聞き返して予約成立も確認すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Even if the visit is another day, I want the time and what to bring written on paper. I will ask again about Japanese instructions on the spot and confirm whether booking was made too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request paper dates, times and items even for another visit day, and say you will ask again about Japanese instructions and confirm a booking exists. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望も伝えます。紹介状と薬の手帳をお手元に、受付からの案内をお待ちください。お待ちの間に状態が変われば職員へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will convey that too. Keep the referral and medicine notebook with you and wait for reception guidance. Tell staff if your condition changes while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋をお届けいただいたのですね。ご自身が拾われた物か、どなたかから預かった物か教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You brought in a bag. Did you find it yourself or receive it from someone else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同僚が道で拾い、私が警察へ来る用事があったので預かりました。私自身が拾った袋ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同僚が拾った袋を警察へ来る用事のある自分が預かったので、自分が拾得者ではないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A colleague found it on the road and entrusted it to me because I had business at the police. I did not find the bag myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain a colleague found the bag and entrusted it to you because you were going to the police, so you are not the finder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同僚の方から、拾った場所と時刻は聞いていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did your colleague tell you the place and time of finding it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店の前の歩道で昼ごろと聞きました。ただ、私は別の道を通ってここへ来たので、その道で拾ったということではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昼ごろ店前の歩道で拾ったと聞き、自分が通った別の道で拾ったわけではないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard around noon on the pavement in front of a shop. But I came here by a different road, so it was not found on the road I used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you heard it was found around noon on pavement outside a shop, not on the different road you took here. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拾った経緯と、お預かりになった経緯を分けて伺います。袋の中について、開けたり中身を出したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will hear the finding circumstances separately from how you received it. Did you open the bag or remove contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は開けていません。同僚は本のような物が見えたと言っていましたが、私が確認した中身としては答えられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分は袋を開けず、同僚の本らしき物という話を自分が確認した中身とは答えられないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not open it. My colleague said something like a book was visible, but I cannot answer that as contents I personally checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you did not open it and cannot report your colleague's book-like-object statement as personally verified contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も分かる範囲で記録します。同僚の方に、詳しい場所や時刻を確認する連絡は取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record that within what is known too. Can you contact your colleague to confirm the detailed location and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡は取れます。今から、目印と覚えている時刻を本人に聞き、分からない所を私の推測で埋めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同僚に連絡でき、目印と記憶する時刻を尋ね推測で補わないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will ask them now for landmarks and the time they remember, without filling unknowns with my own guesses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you can contact your colleague, will ask landmarks and remembered time and will not supplement by guessing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。氏名など記録に必要な情報も案内しますが、拾った方としての希望を、ご本人に代わって決めることはお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. We will guide information needed for records such as names, but refrain from deciding the finder's preferences on their behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同僚の希望は私が勝手に選ばず、本人に確認します。私は預かって持参した経緯を説明し、どちらの連絡先が必要かも教えていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同僚の希望を代理で選ばず本人に確認し、預かり経緯を説明して必要な連絡先を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not choose my colleague's preferences myself; I will ask them. I will explain how I received and brought it, and would also like to know whose contact details are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm your colleague's preferences rather than choose for them, explain being entrusted with it and ask whose contact details are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、まず持参された方の経緯を確認し、同僚の方への確認事項を分けてご案内します。袋はそのまま、こちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: First we will check how the person bringing it received it, and separately explain questions for your colleague. We will take the bag here as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居される方の範囲を伺いたいのですが、ご家族も全員同じ住所へ移られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: To check who is moving, will all family members move to the same address too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 実家から私一人だけ引っ越しました。転送を頼むと同じ名字の家族の分まで新住所に来るのではないかと心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 実家から自分だけ転居し、同姓の家族の郵便まで新住所へ転送されるか心配と相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only I moved from my family home. I worry that requesting forwarding will send mail for family with the same surname to my new address too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss moving alone from the family home and worrying forwarding may include same-surname family mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どなたが転居するかを分けて確認する必要があります。旧住所には、引き続きご家族がお住まいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to identify separately who is moving. Will family continue living at the old address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両親と妹がそのまま住んでいます。私宛ての郵便だけを相談したいので、家族の名前をまとめて書けばよいとは考えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両親と妹は旧住所に残り、自分宛てだけの相談で家族名を一括記入しないようにしたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My parents and younger sister remain there. I want to discuss mail addressed only to me, so will avoid assuming I should write all family names together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say parents and younger sister remain at the old address, you are asking only about your mail and will not list all family names together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申込の範囲と必要な本人確認について、案内で確かめましょう。すでに何らかの申込みを送信されたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the application scope and required identification in the guidance. Have you already submitted any application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ送信していません。全員分の欄に進みかけましたが、選び方が分からず止めています。自分だけの扱いを確認してから出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全員分の欄へ進みかけたが未送信で、自分だけの扱いを確認してから申込みたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I almost proceeded to the all-members section, but stopped because I did not know how to choose. I want to check treatment of me alone before submitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you nearly went to the all-members field but have not submitted, and want to confirm the individual treatment first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送信前であれば、まず内容を整理しましょう。なお、申込んでも、全ての郵便物が同じように転送されるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before submission, let us organize contents first. Even after applying, not all mail is necessarily forwarded in the same way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 全て届くと決めず、利用条件と受付後の確認方法を聞きたいです。実家にも、私宛ての物が届いたら知らせてほしいと頼んでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全郵便が届くと決めず条件と受付後の確認を聞き、実家にも自分宛ての到着を知らせてもらうと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Without assuming everything arrives, I want to ask conditions and how to check after acceptance. I will also ask family to tell me if mail for me arrives there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume all mail arrives, will ask conditions and post-acceptance checks, and ask family to report mail addressed to you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 重要な差出人には、新住所の登録変更も別途お知らせください。郵便の申込みだけで、会社や銀行の登録住所が変わるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Separately inform important senders of your new registered address too. A postal application alone does not change company or bank address registrations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社と銀行には自分で住所変更を連絡します。家族が残る旧住所と自分の新住所、申込対象の名前を見直してから送信します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社と銀行へ別途住所変更を伝え、残る家族の旧住所と自分の新住所、申込む名前を見直して送信すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact work and bank about address changes myself. I will review the old address where family remain, my new address and the applicant name before submitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separately tell work and bank the new address, review family's old address, your new address and names covered, then submit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、転居する方の欄と確認書類の案内を一緒に見ましょう。まだ申込み完了ではありませんので、内容が整ってから手続きを進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us look together at the moving-person field and identification guidance. The application is not complete yet, so proceed after contents are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の変更が済んだか、確かめたいとのことですね。手続きの最後に、受付完了の案内は出ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to check whether the address change is done. Did an acceptance-complete message appear at the end?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい住所を入力したので済んだと思いましたが、最後の案内は見ていません。古い住所に通知が届き、変わっていないのか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新住所を入力して完了と思ったが最後の案内は見ず、旧住所に通知が来て不安と相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I entered the new address so thought it was done, but did not see the final message. A notice arrived at the old address, so I worry it has not changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss thinking new-address entry completed it without seeing the final message, and worrying about a notice arriving at the old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入力だけで完了したとは限りません。保存して閉じたのか、確認後に送信したのか、覚えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Entry alone may not complete it. Do you remember saving and closing, or submitting after confirmation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面には下書き保存と出ていました。送信した覚えはありませんが、入力した内容はもう登録されたと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 下書き保存の表示で送信した記憶はないが、入力だけで登録済みと思ったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The screen said save draft. I do not remember submitting, but thought what I entered was already registered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the display said save draft and you do not remember submitting but thought entry alone registered it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず実際の申請状況を確認する必要があります。続きの操作で、いまお困りの点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First we need to check the actual application status. Any trouble with continuing operations now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認の連絡先に以前の電話番号が出ます。その番号は今使っていないので、住所だけでなく電話番号の相談も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認先が使っていない旧番号なので、住所と電話番号の両方を相談する必要があると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The confirmation contact shows my old phone number. I no longer use it, so need advice on both address and phone number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say confirmation uses an old number no longer used, so both address and phone need discussion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在使えない番号が登録されていることを含め、本人確認の担当へつなぎます。認証を省略できるとは限らないので、個別の方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will connect you to identification staff, including the unusable registered number. Authentication may not be skippable, so let us check a method for your case.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 認証を飛ばすよう頼むのではなく、本人が使える確認方法を教えてほしいです。別の申請を重ねる前に、下書きと受付の状態を調べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 認証省略ではなく本人が使える確認方法を求め、重複申請前に下書きと受付状況の照会を頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than request skipping authentication, I want a verification method I can use myself. Before adding another application, please check draft and acceptance status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for usable identity verification rather than bypass, and request draft and acceptance-status checking before duplicate applications. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承りました。今後の通知先についても、変更の反映時期や、すでに発送された物かによって確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Future notice destinations also need checking according to when changes take effect and whether items were already dispatched.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 届いた通知の日付も持ってきています。登録が変更済みとは決めず、申請状況と今後の送付先を確かめ、必要な本人確認を受けて進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知の日付を示し変更済みと決めず、申請と今後の送付先を確かめ必要な本人確認で進めると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I brought the date of the received notice too. Without deciding registration is already changed, I will check application status and future destinations, undergo required identification and proceed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the notice date, do not assume change is complete, and say you will check application and future delivery destinations and proceed with required identification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、現在の登録と申請状況の照会方法をご案内します。ご本人確認が済むまで、重ねて送信せずこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will explain how to inquire about current registration and application status. Wait here without submitting again until identification is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お菓子の表示について、どなたが召し上がる予定か伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: About the sweets label, may I ask who will eat it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来客用です。乳成分のアレルギーがあると聞いたので、表に植物性と書かれた物ならよいのか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乳成分アレルギーの来客用に、正面の植物性表示ならよいか確かめたいと相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Guests. I heard they have a milk-ingredient allergy, so want to check whether a front label saying plant-based is all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss whether a plant-based front label is suitable for a guest with milk-ingredient allergy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正面の言葉だけでは判断できません。裏面の原材料や注意の表示も見てみましょう。ご本人から、避ける物について案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot judge from front wording alone. Let us see ingredients and cautions on the back too. Did the person give guidance about what to avoid?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乳成分を避けてほしいと聞いただけで、具体的な商品は聞いていません。私の判断で大丈夫だと言って出すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乳成分を避けるとのみ聞き商品指定はなく、自分で大丈夫と判断して出さないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only heard to avoid milk ingredients, not specific products. I will not serve something declaring it fine on my own judgment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say only milk avoidance was requested, with no specified product, and you will not judge it safe and serve it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品の表示で分からない点は、メーカーなどへの確認も必要です。こちらで、召し上がって問題ないと保証することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Unclear points on this product may need confirmation with the manufacturer too. We cannot guarantee here that eating it poses no problem.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この注意書きがよく分からないので、今日はこの商品を保留します。メーカーに聞くときの商品名や問い合わせ先がどこにあるか、教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 注意書きが不明なので商品を保留し、メーカー照会用の商品名と連絡先の欄を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not understand this caution, so will put this product on hold today. Tell me where the product name and manufacturer contact fields are for asking them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put the product on hold because the caution is unclear and ask where its name and manufacturer contact details are. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品名と問い合わせ先の欄はこちらです。別の味の商品でも原材料は同じとは限らないので、代わりを選ぶ際も個別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are the product name and contact fields. Another flavor may not have the same ingredients, so check each item when choosing an alternative too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じシリーズの別の味なら平気だと思っていましたが、それも決めつけません。来客本人に表示を見てもらい、分からない点を確かめてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別の味も同じと決めず、本人に表示を見てもらい不明点を確認してから選ぶと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought another flavor in the same series would be fine, but will not assume that either. I will show the label to the guest and clarify unclear points before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume another flavor is the same, will have the guest look at the label and check unclear points before choosing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保存方法も、未開封と開封後で表示が分かれている場合があります。後で購入なさるときは、こちらの欄もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Storage instructions may be separate for unopened and opened products too. When you purchase later, check this field as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食べられると確認できた物を選ぶ場合も、期限と開封後の扱いを読みます。今は代わりを急いで買わず、本人と確認するため表示を控えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代替品を急いで買わず本人確認用に表示を控え、後に選ぶ際も期限と開封後の扱いを読むと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Even when choosing something confirmed edible, I will read its deadline and handling after opening. I will not rush to buy a replacement now, but want to note the labeling to check with the guest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not rush to buy a substitute, will note labels to check with the guest and read deadlines and after-opening handling when choosing later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示と商品名を確認してお控えください。判断がつかないままご購入にならず、必要な確認が済んでから改めてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check and note the labeling and product name. Do not buy while unable to judge; choose again after necessary checks are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図の印についてお尋ねですね。どの場所まで、どなたと回るご予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a map symbol. How far and with whom do you plan to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車いすを使う友人と散歩します。この印があるので、奥まで一周する道も全部通れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車いすの友人と散歩し、図の印で奥の周回も全て通れると思ったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will walk with a friend using a wheelchair. Because of this symbol, I thought the entire loop further inside would be passable too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain walking with a wheelchair-using friend and thinking the map symbol meant the whole inner loop was passable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この印は、ここにある設備の利用案内を示していて、道全体の状態を表すものではありません。特に確かめたい道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This symbol gives information on using facilities here, not conditions of the entire path. Is there a route you particularly want checked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥の周回に行く道です。印があるだけで段差がないと決めず、路面や途中の通りにくい所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 奥の周回への道を希望し、印だけで段差なしと決めず路面や通りにくい所を知りたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The path to the inner loop. Without assuming the symbol means no steps, I want to know the surface and difficult sections on the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want the route to the inner loop and information on surfaces and difficult sections without assuming step-free from the symbol alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に現在の状態を照会します。図だけでは幅や路面の状況まで分からない所もあります。長い周回を最後まで回る必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask staff about current conditions. Some widths and surfaces cannot be known from the map alone. Must you complete the whole long loop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一周することが目的ではありません。友人と話しながら少し外に出たいので、情報が確かめられる入口近くの範囲でも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一周自体が目的ではなく友人と話しながら外へ出たいので、確認できる入口付近でもよいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Completing a loop is not the purpose. We just want to go outdoors a little while talking, so an area near the entrance with confirmed information is fine too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the loop itself is not the goal, just outdoor conversation with your friend, so the verifiable entrance area is fine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、入口付近の案内を確認しましょう。休憩設備も表示されていますが、使える状況かは別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us check entrance-area guidance. Rest facilities are shown too, but whether they can be used needs separate confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩場所まで必ず行けると考えず、案内を聞いてから友人と決めます。途中で戻る場合の道も、同じように確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩場所への到達を決めず案内後に友人と選び、途中で戻る道も同じように確認したいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume we can definitely reach the rest area, but decide with my friend after hearing guidance. I also want to check the route back if we turn around partway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to choose with your friend after guidance without assuming access to rest areas, and check return routes if turning back midway too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻り道も含めて照会します。同行される方によって必要な条件は異なるので、具体的に気になる幅や段差などは、ご本人ともご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will inquire including return routes. Required conditions vary by companion, so discuss specific concerning widths and steps with the person too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人に必要な条件を聞き、確認できた範囲を伝えて一緒に選びます。分からない道へは進まず、無理なら散歩を短くするつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の必要条件を聞いて確認済み範囲を共有し、不明な道へ進まず無理なら短くすると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my friend's needs, share the confirmed range and choose together. We will not enter unknown paths, and will shorten the walk if difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your friend's needs, share confirmed areas and not enter unknown paths, shortening the walk if needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご相談の条件を伺って担当へ伝えます。周回へ進む前に、入口付近と戻り道についての案内をこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will hear your conditions and tell staff. Before heading to the loop, wait here for guidance about the entrance area and return routes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは駅前へ出る側の通路です。改札へ向かわれるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: This passage leads out to the station-front side. Are you going to the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。大きな荷物があるのでエレベーターを探しましたが、案内には「駅前広場」と出ています。これでホームへ行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きな荷物でエレベーターを探したが駅前広場の表示があり、ホームへ行ける設備か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. With large luggage I looked for an elevator, but its sign says station-front plaza. Can this take me to the platform?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you sought an elevator with large luggage but the sign says station-front plaza, and ask whether it goes to the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのエレベーターは広場へ出るためのものです。ホームへ上がる設備は改札の内側にあります。切符はもうお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That elevator is for going out to the plaza. The equipment up to the platform is inside the gates. Have you already got a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 切符はあります。では広場へ出ずに改札へ行きたいのですが、この階のまま進めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符は持っており広場へ出ず改札へ行くため、同じ階で進めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Then I want the gates without going to the plaza; can I go on this same floor?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have a ticket and ask whether you can go to the gates on this floor without going to the plaza. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この通路から改札へ進めます。階段に下りる必要はありません。改札内では、乗るホームの番号を先に確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, this passage leads to the gates. No need to go down stairs. Inside the gates, check your platform number first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 切符にはホーム番号が見当たりません。列車名と出発時刻がわかるこの予約画面で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切符でホーム番号が見つからず、列車名と時刻の予約画面で確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot find the platform number on the ticket. Can I check with this booking screen showing train name and departure time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the ticket has no platform number you can find, and you want to check using the booking screen's train name and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 画面と発車案内を照合できます。ホームがわかったら、そのホームへ行くエレベーターの表示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can compare the screen and departure display. Once you know the platform, check elevator signs to that platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号がわかってから設備を選ぶのですね。重い荷物を持ったまま表示を探すのが難しいので、改札の係員にも案内を頼みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ホーム番号確定後に設備を選ぶと理解し、重い荷物のため改札係にも案内を頼みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So choose the equipment after knowing the number. Finding signs while holding heavy luggage is difficult, so I also want to request guidance from gate staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show understanding to choose equipment after the platform number, and say you want gate staff's guidance because of heavy luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 改札の係員に、階段を避けたいことと荷物があることをお伝えください。ここから連絡して、ご案内の方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell gate staff about the luggage and wanting to avoid stairs. We will contact them from here and check how to guide you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。私は広場へ出るエレベーターには乗らず、この階の通路で改札へ進み、ホーム番号を確かめてから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広場行き設備を使わず同階の改札へ進み、ホーム番号を確認後に移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will not take the plaza elevator, but use this floor's passage to the gates and move on after checking the platform number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not use the plaza equipment, will go to the gates on this floor and move after confirming the platform number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 改札係へお伝えします。予約画面をご用意いただき、通路の「改札」の表示に沿ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will tell gate staff. Have the booking screen ready and follow the passage's ticket-gates signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の手続きですね。引っ越しの時期がわかるものと、新しい住所を確認できるものをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Address procedures, then. Have you brought something showing moving timing and confirming the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 契約書を持っています。ただ、荷物を運んだ日と住み始めた日が違うので、どの日を伝えればよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約書はあるが荷物搬入と居住開始が異なり、伝える日付を迷っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The contract. But the day of bringing belongings and starting residence differ, so I am unsure which date to report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you have the contract but belongings arrival and residence start differ, making the reported date unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一つの日にまとめず、どのように移ったか担当に説明しましょう。荷物の搬入と実際の生活開始を区別して教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not combine into one day; explain how you moved to staff. Tell us belongings delivery separately from actual living start.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先に荷物だけ運び、私は前の部屋で二晩過ごしてから新居へ移りました。申請欄にはまだ日付を書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物搬入後も旧居で二晩過ごしてから移り、申請日付は未記入と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I first moved only belongings, then spent two nights in the old room before moving to the new home. I have not entered a date in the application field yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say after moving belongings you stayed two nights in the old home before moving, and the application date field is blank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経緯を引き継ぎます。新住所は契約書で最後まで読めますか。建物名や部屋番号も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will pass that on. Can the new address be read fully from the contract? Check building name and room number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 建物名は読めますが、契約書の写しでは部屋番号の最後が切れています。記憶している番号を書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 契約書写しで部屋番号末尾が切れており、推測の番号を書いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The building name is readable, but the end of the room number is cut off on the contract copy. May I write the number I remember?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the contract copy cuts off the room number's end and ask whether you may write a guessed number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 推測で書かず、管理会社などに正確な番号を確認してください。確認できていない点も担当には伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not guess; check the exact number with management or similar. Tell staff about unconfirmed points too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では番号は空けて相談します。同行していない家族は後日引っ越す予定ですが、家族も私と同じ日に住み始めたと書くのは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 部屋番号は空欄で相談し、家族は後日転居のため自分と同じ日に居住開始と書かないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will leave the number blank and consult. Family not accompanying me plan to move later, so writing they began living the same day as me would be wrong, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will consult with room number blank and confirm not to give family your residence-start date because they move later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ移っていない方も含め、実際の状況を分けてお伝えください。必要な手続きや書類はこちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Distinguish actual circumstances including people not yet moved. We will check necessary procedures and documents here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分が移った経緯と家族はまだ来ていないことを分けて説明します。部屋番号を正確に確認し、日付の記入も担当に聞いてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人と家族の状況を分け、部屋番号を正確に確認して日付は担当に聞いてから記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will separately explain my move and that family have not come yet. I will confirm the exact room number and ask staff before filling the date too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish your and family's circumstances, confirm the exact room number and fill the date only after asking staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは未記入の箇所がある用紙と契約書をお持ちになり、担当窓口へお進みください。今の不明点をメモにしてお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take the form with unfilled sections and contract to the responsible counter. We will give you notes of the current unknowns.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約票が二枚ありますね。変更したいのはどちらのご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: There are two appointment slips. Which plan do you want changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事と重なったので検査を別の日にしたいです。ただ、その後の診察も予約してあり、検査だけ変えてよいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事で検査を変えたいが後の診察予約もあり、検査だけ変えてよいか不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Work overlaps, so I want the test moved to another day. But a consultation is booked afterward too, so I do not know if changing only the test is all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say work requires moving the test but a later consultation is booked too, so you do not know whether changing only the test is acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査と診察のつながりを確認する必要があります。今の二枚を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the link between test and consultation. May we see both current slips?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。検査は午前、診察は同じ日の午後です。両方を次の週へ動かせるなら、仕事の調整がしやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査午前と同日午後の診察票を示し、両方次週なら仕事を調整しやすいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. The test is morning and consultation afternoon of the same day. If both can move to the next week, adjusting work will be easier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show morning test and same-day afternoon consultation slips, and say both next week would ease work arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次の週を希望として担当へ伝えます。検査の結果を診察で確認する予定かなど、予約担当と診療側に照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will tell staff next week as a preference. We will ask booking and clinical teams whether test results are to be reviewed at the consultation and related matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだどちらも取り消さないでください。次の組合せが確認できるまでは、今の予約をどう扱うかも教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次の組合せがわかる前に取り消さず、現予約の扱いも確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Do not cancel either yet. Until the next combination is confirmed, I want to know how the present bookings will be handled too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask not to cancel before the new combination is known and request checking treatment of current bookings too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。変更依頼として取り次ぎ、今の予約の扱いも確認します。現在の状態に変化や、新たに伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We will pass it as a change request and check current bookings' treatment. Any change in your current condition or new information to give?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今のところ自分では変化を感じていません。ただ、それで受診を遅らせてよいとは判断せず、希望だけ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自覚的変化はないが延期可能とは自己判断せず、変更希望として引き継ぐよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I personally feel no change so far. But I will not judge that means a visit can be delayed; please pass on only my change preference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you feel no change but will not self-judge postponement acceptable, and ask to hand over as a change request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように引き継ぎます。検査前の準備も、新しい予定が決まった場合は担当から改めて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will pass it on that way. If a new plan is set, check test preparations again with staff too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 前の予約票の準備をそのまま当てはめず、新しい日時と準備の説明を一緒に聞きます。まず変更の返答を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 前予約の準備を流用せず、新日時と準備説明を一緒に確認して変更返答を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not apply preparations from the old slip unchanged, but ask together about the new time and preparation instructions. First I will wait for the change reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not reuse old preparations, will check new dates and preparations together and wait for the change reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では二枚の予約票を照合して担当へ連絡します。変更が確定するまで、こちらの案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will compare both slips and contact staff. Wait for our guidance until the change is confirmed.
